course.title: Corrosion and Surface Engineering
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Enameled surfaces of food and beverage cans often exposed to atmosphere and Red Brown (10) corrosion filaments are visible. The corrosion filaments consist of an active head and an inactive tails. Explain the corrosion initiation mechanism with propagation.
